content: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
author: Oscar Wilde
story: During the zenith of Victorian London's rigid social conformity, Oscar Wilde weaponized wit to expose the absurdity of hypocrisy and imitation. In aristocratic drawing rooms where individuals performed scripted roles to please societal expectations, Wilde championed radical individuality, insisting that mimicking others is the ultimate betrayal of one's own singular spark.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you subtly copying expectations rather than honoring your authentic instincts and values?
